parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in the `PlaybackTests` test target under `Shared/Playback/Tests/`. Despite a Jaccard similarity of ~0.71, the methods have distinct names (`multiplePlayCallsAreIdempotent` vs `overrideWhilePlayingIsHandled`) that encode different behavioral scenarios under test — idempotent play calls versus route-change override handling — so the structural similarity is coincidental to the test scaffolding pattern rather than indicative of extractable logic. Merging or abstracting these test bodies would obscure the intent of each individual behavioral test case.
